# 1 Enoch Chapter 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**36:1** And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew and rain and wind.

**36:2** And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw there the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.

**36:3** Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.

**36:4** And as often as I saw, I blessed always the Lord of Glory, and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of his work to the angels and to human beings, that these might praise his work and all his creatures: that they might see the work of his power and praise the great work of his hands and bless him for ever.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 36 is the conclusion of the Book of Watchers (chs. 1-36): the southern and eastern portals (vv. 1-3), and Enoch's final doxology blessing the Lord of Glory for his great and glorious works (v. 4). The concluding doxology of v. 4 is a fitting end to the first major section of 1 Enoch. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
